subTasks.title: Create divorce document inventory

subTasks.title: Review planning impact points
subTasks.text: Identify planning items that may affect cash flow, taxes, account titling, retirement assets, insurance, estate documents, and beneficiary designations. Note questions for the advisor and avoid providing legal interpretation.

subTasks.title: Coordinate professional follow-up
subTasks.text: Prepare a concise outreach summary for the client's attorney, CPA, or other professional contacts using placeholders for names and contact details. Confirm client authorization before sharing any documents.

subTasks.title: Finalize advisor review notes
subTasks.text: Summarize open issues, received evidence, and recommended next planning steps for advisor review before any plan update or client meeting.
